crosswalks.label: Business Continuity Planners
crosswalks.rationale: Business Continuity Planners is a bounded occupational baseline for Business Continuity Specialist; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Business Continuity must separate documented plans/targets from demonstrated recoverability and expose correlated dependencies rather than assuming redundancy.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make plan-versus-tested-capability, correlated-dependency and degraded-mode authority boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Business Continuity Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
